cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28...4.5)
project(t02_thirdparty LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../cmake")
include(HeaderUnits)
include(../common/ExternalLibs.cmake)

add_header_units(hu_std  HEADERS vector string iostream)
add_header_units(hu_fmt  HEADERS fmt/format.h      LINK_LIBRARIES fmt::fmt)
add_header_units(hu_json HEADERS nlohmann/json.hpp LINK_LIBRARIES nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json)
if(HU_HAVE_BOOST)
  add_header_units(hu_boost HEADERS boost/optional.hpp LINK_LIBRARIES Boost::headers)
endif()

add_executable(t02 all.cpp fmt_only.cpp both.cpp)
target_link_libraries(t02 PRIVATE fmt::fmt nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json)
if(HU_HAVE_BOOST)
  target_link_libraries(t02 PRIVATE Boost::headers)
  target_compile_definitions(t02 PRIVATE HU_HAVE_BOOST)
endif()
target_import_header_units(t02 hu_std  SOURCES all.cpp both.cpp)
target_import_header_units(t02 hu_fmt  SOURCES all.cpp fmt_only.cpp both.cpp)
target_import_header_units(t02 hu_json SOURCES all.cpp)
if(HU_HAVE_BOOST)
  target_import_header_units(t02 hu_boost SOURCES all.cpp)
endif()

enable_testing()
add_test(NAME t02 COMMAND t02)
